channel.title: OpenAI Research & Releases
channel.description: Latest research papers and model releases from OpenAI

item.title: Two years of OpenAI Academy
item.description: Marking two years of OpenAI Academy and bringing AI skills to even more communities.

item.title: OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense
item.description: OpenAI is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.

item.title: Sam Altman’s remarks at the United Nations Security Council
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman discusses AI safety, human control, and international cooperation in remarks to the United Nations Security Council.

item.title: Harvey turns legal context into stronger drafts with GPT-6 Astra
item.description: GPT-6 Astra produces more structured, context-aware legal documents, freeing lawyers to focus on strategy.

item.title: How invideo improves color grading 3x with GPT‑6 Astra
item.description: With GPT‑6 Astra, invideo plans edits with greater precision, improves color correction and grading threefold, and produces 50 custom effects in one day.

item.title: Ringg’s AI agents resolve up to 65% of customer calls with OpenAI
item.description: Using GPT-5.6, Ringg powers multilingual agents across voice, chat, WhatsApp, and web for 90% less cost vs. GPT-4.1.

item.title: Introducing MentalHealthBench
item.description: MentalHealthBench is an expert-informed benchmark for evaluating helpful and safe AI responses across realistic mental health conversations.

item.title: ChatGPT Ads expands to Southeast Asia and Taiwan
item.description: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to Southeast Asia and Taiwan, giving eligible businesses new ways to reach people across more than 60 countries.

item.title: Airbnb widens access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models
item.description: Learn how Airbnb is expanding access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models to help engineering teams solve bugs, design systems, and ship faster.

item.title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
item.description: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.

item.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
item.description: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.

item.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
item.description: Meet GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models that bring frontier intelligence to everyday work with different balances of capability and cost.

item.title: Parallel cut research time and cost in half with GPT‑6 Astra
item.description: GPT‑6 Astra allowed Parallel’s agents to research and synthesize labor-market data in half the time and at half the cost vs. prior models.

item.title: Priorities and principles for effective third party assessments
item.description: OpenAI outlines priorities and principles for rigorous, secure, and independent third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models and safeguards.

item.title: Higgsfield AI ships new video features in a day with GPT-6 Astra
item.description: With GPT-6 Astra, Higgsfield AI makes video ad creation easier for small businesses and brings new creative tools to market faster.

item.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
item.description: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.

item.title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
item.description: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting, and governance to improve safety.

item.title: Expanding OpenAI Academy with new learning paths
item.description: Explore new OpenAI Academy learning paths for employees, developers, leaders, educators, and students to build and demonstrate practical AI skills.

item.title: How V7 gives AI agents institutional memory
item.description: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work.

item.title: Introducing the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint
item.description: OpenAI introduces the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, a six-pillar roadmap for safer AI experiences that protect and empower young people.
